altText.nob: Systemdiagram som viser Phoenix-API-en, Postgres-laget, søkemotoren og innholdsgrafen i Barkpark.
altText.eng: A system diagram showing the Phoenix API, the Postgres layer, the search engine, and the content graph that make up Barkpark.

caption.nob: Slik henger Barkpark sammen: én innholdsmodell, mange flater — TUI, CLI, web-demo og SDK leser samme API.
caption.eng: How Barkpark fits together: one content model feeding many surfaces — the Go TUI, the bp CLI, the Next.js web demo, and the JS SDK all read the same API.

fields.description: Reference architecture for the Barkpark headless CMS — the Phoenix API at the center, Postgres for storage and full-text search, the Indx retriever seam, and the content graph that turns reference fields into edges. Used in engineering blog posts about schema, search, and the content-graph.

rights.usageNotes: Diagram is open-source under the same license as the Barkpark repo. Re-export from the source file before editing.
